title: Arrest of a Florida Woman Blocking Customers at Checkout
description:
On October 27th, 2022 Escambia County Sheriff's Office received a report of an incident, at Beacon Food Store in Pensacola, Florida. The Incident involved a white female, described as wearing a Gray hoodie and jeans causing a disturbance by placing hands on everyone and blocking customers from making purchases. At the time of the incident, the female had an active trespass on the property.

On arrival at the scene the female, fled from one of the officers. She was then detained and continued resisting officers' lawful orders as well as physically resisting officers. She was placed under arrest and detained in a patrol vehicle.

The store staff stated she was asked to leave while inside the store but refused after being asked. He later explained she would not stop putting her hands on other customers and blocked them from using the checkout. On October 25th she had been issued an Active Trespass Warning at this same location.

Upon arriving at the jail the female suspect refused to exit the patrol vehicle. When asked several times by an officer to exit the vehicle she actively refused. She stated she was afraid the officer would “electric shock” her. She later agreed to exit the vehicle if the officer would agree to “hold her hand”. When arriving inside the main area of the building she began resisting and became verbally aggressive. On-site staff had to restrain the female suspect to proceed with the booking. 

She was later charged with trespassing and resisting an officer without violence.
